verdict.rationale: Semgrep publishes an AppSec Platform API (semgrep-docs-17) that lets users list deployments, gather findings, and list projects, and core scanning is also fully scriptable via the CLI (semgrep-docs-19, semgrep-docs-27). However, the documented API surface is narrow (read-only listing/findings) with no evidence it covers rule management, policy configuration, Secrets/Supply Chain triage actions, or Managed Scans setup that are available in the UI, and no OpenAPI spec is discoverable (semgrep-probe-2 shows 404s). Missing for 10: full CRUD parity for rules/policies via API, documented API coverage for Secrets/Supply Chain/Managed Scans features, and a public OpenAPI/swagger spec confirming full surface area.
